metadata-extraction.quality_boundary: Source-bound field extraction only; preserve explicit source IDs, unknowns and exact values. Never exclude literature, infer support or write scientific conclusions.

format-conversion.quality_boundary: Formatting assistance only after deterministic tools. Luna format conversion has not been accepted. Preserve all facts, citations, numbers and uncertainty; validate candidate output.

screening-assist.quality_boundary: Luna screening has not been accepted. Source-bound advisory screening retains all exclusions and requires scientific review.

evidence-synthesis.quality_boundary: Source-bound internal synthesis; retain conflicts, exact evidence locators and unknowns. No automatic claim acceptance.

scientific-judgment.quality_boundary: Evidence-bound scientific analysis subject to independent audits and human gates.

independent-critique.quality_boundary: Fresh read-only independent audit; never persist scientific artifacts or approve a gate.

reader-translation.quality_boundary: Faithful personal-reading translation preserving source pages, numbers, citations and uncertainty; not verified citation evidence.

reader-qa.quality_boundary: Personal source-bound reading answers with exact supplied page locators. Abstain for missing material; never convert an internal answer into verified citation evidence.

engineering-diagnosis.quality_boundary: Internal read-only engineering diagnostics from supplied logs/code. OpenAI performs any persistent remediation; never determine scientific validity.

multimodal-inspection.quality_boundary: Internal source-bound image/PDF inspection; never generate result figures, replace human visual review or certify scientific claims.
